_readme: Targeted mutation testing (#64) — client-package pure boundaries only.
mutate: deterministic, security/correctness-heavy pure code (connection-string parse/quote,
certificate hostname validation). Nothing that touches Docker, the AppHost model, or the
native LDAP boundary is mutated: a mutant there would be killed by a container start, not
test-case-filter: Category!=Integration — a mutation run must never start a container.
thresholds.break: derived from the MEASURED baseline (90.59% at the time of writing),
less a 2-point margin for run-to-run timeout jitter. It is a ratchet: raise it when the
score rises; never lower it to make a run pass. Survivor policy: docs/testing.md.
